description: This file defines the EmailProcessor entity class in PHP, which is mapped to the 'ohrm_email_processor' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations. It contains properties representing the email processor's ID, associated email, and class name, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailProcessor
classes.description: Entity class representing an email processor, mapped to the 'ohrm_email_processor' database table with properties for ID, associated email, and class name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email processor.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email processor.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Associates an Email entity with this EmailProcessor.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name used for processing.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name used for processing.
